fatalExceptionAudit.conclusion: Target runtime call sites were converted to fail-closed returns/blackbox records. The legacy exception type remains for existing neighboring-domain callers outside 1310 authority.

failClosedSummary.lockDuringCompaction: TryAcquireWriteLock/TryLockBuffer return false on first volatile fence gate.
failClosedSummary.externalViewAdmission: Writer locks and owner read pins reject BlockFlagExternalView so persistent read aliases cannot mix with mutable or releasable pin routes.
failClosedSummary.persistentAliasAdmission: TryOpenAliasBuffer rejects any existing BlockFlagExternalView or LastAliasRequester because persistent aliases have no release token.
failClosedSummary.lockedBlockDuringCompaction: Compaction skips and records LockedSkipCount plus AliasBlocked flag.
failClosedSummary.arenaGrowthDuringActiveAlias: Growth returns false and queues _deferredArenaGrowthBytes when active locks or external views exist.
failClosedSummary.telemetryFault: Fault paths request raw 1310 dump; hot ring writes stay unmanaged.

overengineeringReview.mathIterations: linear block scan only; no physical simulation or spatial solver added
overengineeringReview.dearLie: skip-and-record, mask gates, and fixed telemetry ring instead of waiting or simulating allocator pressure

checks.name: TryAcquireWriteLock_first_line_compaction_fence

checks.name: TryLockBuffer_first_line_compaction_fence
checks.evidence: first executable statement must reject active compaction

checks.name: TryAcquireWriteLock_publishes_active_bit_inside_mutation_gate
checks.evidence: active bit is published only after the block mutation gate is held and before writer id publication

checks.name: TryLockBuffer_publishes_active_bit_inside_mutation_gate
checks.evidence: pin bit is published inside the mutation gate before the private block pin is incremented

checks.name: ReleaseWriteLock_uses_volatile_and_interlocked_release
checks.evidence: writer release path must use volatile read and interlocked zeroing

checks.name: ReleaseWriteLock_clears_writer_and_active_bit_inside_mutation_gate
checks.evidence: writer release must clear private block lock, writer id, and active bit while the same mutation gate is still held

checks.name: TryAcquireWriteLock_partial_rollback_is_under_existing_gate
checks.evidence: unpublished writer lock rollback must occur while the caller still owns the mutation gate; no bounded second-gate failure path

checks.name: TryUnlockBuffer_clears_active_bit_under_mutation_gate
checks.evidence: pin unlock clears active bit while the block gate is still held

checks.name: TryOpenAliasBuffer_marks_external_view_before_native_view
checks.evidence: read-only alias must publish the external-view relocation pin and alias requester under one mutation gate before constructing a NativeArray view

checks.name: TryOpenAliasBuffer_rolls_back_unpublished_alias_pin_on_failure
checks.evidence: alias open must not leave BlockFlagExternalView/LastAliasRequester pinned when no alias is returned

checks.name: TryOpenAliasBuffer_rejects_existing_persistent_alias
checks.evidence: persistent read aliases have no release token, so a second alias must fail closed instead of overwriting LastAliasRequester

checks.name: MarkExternalView_uses_compaction_aware_mutation_gate
checks.evidence: external-view pin publication must be serialized with compaction and block metadata mutation

checks.name: MarkAliasReader_uses_mutation_gate_and_requires_external_view
checks.evidence: alias-reader metadata updates must be serialized with relocation metadata and only apply to already-pinned external views

checks.name: Pure_transient_read_views_recheck_fence_after_view_creation
checks.evidence: pure read accessors must not pin relocation metadata, but they must reject if compaction/growth starts while a transient view is being created

checks.name: Read_alias_path_does_not_sanitize_or_mutate_payload
checks.evidence: read and read-alias routes must not repair or rewrite payload data; finite sanitization belongs only to owner allocation/resize paths

checks.name: TryLockBuffer_partial_pin_rollback_is_under_existing_gate
checks.evidence: unpublished buffer pin rollback must occur before releasing the mutation gate; no bounded second-gate failure path

checks.name: TryLockBuffer_owner_bound_pin_and_unlock
checks.evidence: read pins must be owner-bound so one domain cannot unlock another domain's live NativeArray pin

checks.name: ExternalView_blocks_writer_and_read_pin_admission

checks.name: No_production_single_arg_buffer_pin_calls

checks.name: No_production_persistent_read_alias_calls
